title: Karma
cn: 第 18 集 · 因果报应
novel: Barney [[pursued|pursue]] Quinn even after learning she was a [[stripper|stripper]]. He met her at a strip club and was immediately [[attracted|attract]] to her. She was different from anyone he had ever met. She was smart, [[witty|witty]], and could match his sense of humor. Barney did not care about her job. He felt a [[genuine|genuine]] connection with her. He tried to [[impress|impress]] her with his charm and wealth, but Quinn was not easily [[fooled|fool]]. She saw through his [[act|act]] and challenged him to be himself. Barney was not used to a woman who could see through his [[tricks|trick]]. He found it both [[frustrating|frustrate]] and exciting. Meanwhile, Marshall and Lily [[introduced|introduce]] Robin to [[suburban|suburban]] life. They wanted to show her that the suburbs were not as boring as she thought. They took her to a local diner and a small park. Robin was not [[impressed|impress]] at first. She complained about the slow pace and lack of [[excitement|excitement]]. But as the day went on, Robin started to [[relax|relax]] and enjoy the quiet. She realized that the suburbs had their own [[charm|charm]]. Marshall and Lily were happy to see Robin [[warming|warm]] up to their new home. Quinn eventually agreed to go on a real date with Barney. She told him to leave his [[playbook|playbook]] at home and just be honest. Barney agreed and felt [[nervous|nervous]] about being himself for the first time.

pursue.en: to try to get something or someone

stripper.en: someone who performs in a club

witty.en: clever and funny at the same time

playbook.en: a book of strategies or tricks
